outcomes.criterion: The agent issues a refund after the caller turns down the replacement
outcomes.evidence: turn 3: "agent:  I can process a refund for you. Confirming the refund now."

outcomes.criterion: The agent tells the caller how long the refund takes to reach their card
outcomes.evidence: turn 4: "agent:  The refund takes five to seven business days to reach your card."
